name: Clean-ImageNet-OOD-Benchmarks
description: A suite of out-of-distribution ImageNet-style test sets designed to evaluate model robustness to distribution shift and corrupted or atypical images. It measures how well image classification models trained on ImageNet generalize to challenging OOD variants. Useful for benchmarking robustness and calibration under natural distribution shifts.
reputation: Moderately used in robustness research as a targeted OOD evaluation for ImageNet models, though not as ubiquitous as some other robustness suites.
